note: A model with fixed random seeds. Fees are measured contract sizes at 1 satoshi per byte; nothing here was broadcast.
playerMix: casual 60% (1 service a week), regular 30% (3 a week, 20,000 deposited), heavy 10% (7 a week, 100,000 deposited); attacker and defender each win half of the raids

scenario.adversaries: 5% of players start an exit whenever they lose a raid; attestors are unreachable for more than two days in 1% of settlements

ratios.zeroSum: every satoshi a raid moves comes from one player and reaches another; the only loss is the network fee
